_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_AFTER_CHANGE_DESCRI: Hook after every change: ({ operation, path, value, document }).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOW_MOVE_DESCRIPT: Elements can be moved (Alt+arrows, drag and drop, cut and paste).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOW_TYPE_CHANGE_D: The type of a value can be changed.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_VARIA: Unknown variables are warnings, not errors.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOWED_TYPES_DESCR: Types that can be chosen, e.g. ["string", "number"].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ARRAY_PAGE_SIZE_DES: Big arrays show this many elements, then a row "show more".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_ADD_DESCRIPT: Hook before adding: false stops it, another value is the new value.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_CHANGE_DESCR: Hook before every change (also async): false stops it, another value replaces it.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_MOVE_DESCRIP: Hook before moving: false stops it.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_REMOVE_DESCR: Hook before removing, e.g. an own confirmation: false (or a Promise with false) stops it.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_RENAME_DESCR: Hook before renaming: false stops it, a string is the new key.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_SET_DESCRIPT: Hook before a new value: false stops it, another value replaces it.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BEFORE_TYPE_CHANGE_: Hook before a change of the type: false stops it, another value replaces the converted value.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BLOCK_INVALID_SAVE_: A text with a syntax error does not change the model.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_CONFIRM_REMOVE_DESC: true or "containers": the removal is confirmed with AConfirm (needs AModalConfirm). Without it the removal can be undone.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_DISPLAY_FORMATTERS_: Functions for the view of a type, e.g. { number: value => filterCurrency(value) }; the data stay.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_EMPTY_CONTAINERS_DE: Empty containers in the text: "{}" or "{ }".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ERROR_SUMMARY_POSIT: Place of the error summary: "top" or "bottom".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ESCAPE_UNICODE_DESC: Characters outside ASCII as ä in the text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_EXPAND_LEVEL_DESCRI: The levels that are open at the start (1 = the root).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_EXPANDED_PATHS_DESC: Paths that are open at the start, e.g. ["/users/0"].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_FORMAT_ON_DESCRIPTI: "blur": the text is formatted when it loses the focus.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_FORMAT_OPTIONS_DESC: All options of the text in one object; a single prop wins.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_GET_NODE_ACTIONS_DE: Own actions of a row: ({ value, path, type }) => [{ id, label, when, run }].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_GET_VALUE_TYPE_DESC: Own type of a value: ({ value, path }) => name of a plugin type.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_HEIGHT_DESCRIPTION_: Fixed height of the tree and the text, e.g. "24rem".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_HIDDEN_PATHS_DESCRI: Paths that are not shown, e.g. ["/password"].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_INDENT_DESCRIPTION_: Indent of the text: number of spaces or "tab".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_INLINE_ARRAYS_DESCR: Short arrays of primitives in one line: true or the maximal length of the line.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_INLINE_OBJECTS_DESC: Small objects of primitives in one line: true or the maximal length of the line.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_KEYBOARD_HINT_DESCR: The hint of the keys for screen readers (in aria-describedby of the tree).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_LINE_ENDING_DESCRIP: End of the lines of the text: "lf" or "crlf".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_LOAD_CHILDREN_DESCR: Hook that loads the content of a node before it is expanded (also async).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_LOCKED_KEYS_DESCRIP: Paths that cannot be removed, renamed or moved, e.g. ["/id"].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MAX_DEPTH_DESCRIPTI: Maximal depth of the nodes (1 = only the keys of the root).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MAX_ERRORS_DESCRIPT: Maximal number of the shown errors.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MAX_HEIGHT_DESCRIPT: Maximal height of the tree and the text (scroll).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MAX_LINE_LENGTH_DES: Line length for inline-arrays and inline-objects.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MINIFY_DESCRIPTION_: The text is always without indent (one line).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MODEL_TYPE_DESCRIPT: "object": the model is a JS value; "string": the model is a JSON text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIP: The document: an object, an array, a primitive or (model-type="string") a JSON text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MODES_DESCRIPTION_: The modes of the switch in the toolbar.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_NUMBER_FORMAT_DESCR: Function for numbers in the text, e.g. value => value.toFixed(2).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ON_SELECT_DESCRIPTI: Hook when a node gets active: ({ path, tokens, value }).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_PARSE_DESCRIPTION_: Own parse of the model with model-type="string", e.g. JSON5.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_PATH_FORMAT_DESCRIP: Format of a copied path and of the messages: "dot" (users[0].name) or "pointer" (/users/0/name).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_PLUGINS_DESCRIPTION: Plugins: own types, actions, buttons, hooks and translations (also global with AJsonEditorPlugin).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_READONLY_DESCRIPTIO: Only to read: search, expand and copy, no changes.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_READONLY_PATHS_DESC: Paths that cannot be changed, also their content, e.g. ["/meta"].
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_RESET_VALUE_DESCRIP: The value of "reset"; by default the first value of the model.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ROW_HEIGHT_DESCRIPT: Height of the virtual rows in px.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_RULES_DESCRIPTION_: Rules by path ("*" for any index or key): type, required, min, max, minLength, maxLength, pattern, enum, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, keys, additionalKeys, level, message.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SCHEMA_DESCRIPTION_: A subset of JSON Schema: type, enum, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, pattern, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SEARCH_CASE_SENSITI: The search distinguishes upper and lower case at the start.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DES: Wait in ms before the search runs.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SEARCH_FILTER_DESCR: Show only the matches and their parents at the start.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SEARCH_REGEX_DESCRI: The search is a regular expression at the start.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_COUNTS_DESCRIP: The number of the elements of objects and arrays.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_ERROR_SUMMARY_: The summary of the errors with links to the nodes.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_GUIDES_DESCRIP: The guide lines of the levels.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_HISTORY_DESCRI: The button with the list of the steps of the history.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_INDEXES_DESCRI: The indexes of the elements of arrays.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_RESOLVED_DESCR: Show the values of the variables (variable-values) at the start.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SHOW_STATUS_BAR_DES: The status bar: path, number of nodes, errors, undo after a removal.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SORT_KEYS_DESCRIPTI: Keys sorted in the text: true / "asc", "desc" or a function (a, b) => number.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SPACE_AFTER_COLON_D: A space after the colon in the text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_STRING_MAX_LENGTH_D: Long strings are cut in the view (the full text is in the title).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_STRINGIFY_DESCRIPTI: Own stringify of the model with model-type="string".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_TRAILING_NEWLINE_DE: A line break at the end of the text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_: Type of the element in AForm: type: "jsonEditor".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_UNDO_LIMIT_DESCRIPT: Maximal number of the steps of the history.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VALIDATE_DOCUMENT_D: Hook for the whole document (also async, e.g. a full JSON Schema): errors as string, array or { path, level, message }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VALIDATE_NODE_DESCR: Hook for every node: ({ value, path }) => error text, array or { level, message }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VALIDATE_ON_DESCRIP: When the errors are shown: "change" (at once), "blur", "submit" or "none" (only with validate()).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VARIABLE_PATTERN_DE: The marks of a variable, default { open: "{{", close: "}}" }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VARIABLE_VALUES_DES: Values of the variables for "show with the values" and resolveVariables.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VARIABLES_DESCRIPTI: The variables: [{ name, label, type, example, group }] or a function ({ query }) => array or Promise.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD_D: From this number of rows only the visible rows are rendered (aria-rowcount, aria-rowindex).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AJsonEditor edits JSON as a tree and as text: keys and values in place, types, adding, removing, moving, search, history with undo, redo and reset, own variables, rules and JSON Schema, formatting by props, hooks and plugins.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION:
Accessibility:

  • The tree is a WAI-ARIA treegrid with a name (label), rows with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset and aria-expanded, one tab stop and the keys of the APG; no role="application".
  • Every row says key, value and type; errors are in aria-describedby, collapsed nodes say "3 errors inside". The summary of the errors has links to the nodes.
  • Editing in the row: the field has a name ("Value of name"), Enter saves, Escape cancels, the focus goes back to the row. The variables are a combobox with a listbox.
  • The actions of a row are a WAI-ARIA menu (Shift+F10); every action also has a key. Drag and drop has the keyboard alternative Alt+arrows and cut / paste.
  • One live region says what happened: added, removed (with Ctrl+Z), undone, the number of the matches. Big documents keep the treegrid with aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex.
  • The colors of the types have enough contrast and the type is also written as text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_KEYBOARD_DESCRIPTION_:
Keys in the tree:

  • ↑ ↓ rows, → open / first child, ← close / parent, Home End, Page Up Page Down, * open all siblings
  • Enter / F2 edit the value, Shift+F2 rename, Alt+F2 type, Escape cancel
  • Insert / Ctrl+Enter add, Delete remove, Ctrl+D duplicate, Alt+↑ Alt+↓ move, Ctrl+C Ctrl+X Ctrl+V
  • Shift+F10 actions, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y redo, Ctrl+F search, F3 next match, F8 next error; in a text field {{ or Ctrl+Space opens the variables
  • Space select a row, Shift+↑ Shift+↓ more rows, Ctrl+A all, Escape clear the selection; in a text Shift+Enter a new line
  • Ctrl+H search and replace; in the text with an error the button Repair
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EVENTS_SEARCH_DESCRIPTION: The search was changed: { query, count }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EVENTS_SELECT_DESCRIPTION: A node got active: { path, tokens, value }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EVENTS_VALIDATE_DESCRIPTI: The errors were changed: { isValid, errors: [{ pointer, level, message, extra }] }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION_: Content when there is no document.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_STATUS_DESCRIPTION_: Own content in the status bar: { document, activePath }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_TOOLBAR_APPEND_DESC: Own content at the end of the toolbar.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_TOOLBAR_PREPEND_DES: Own content at the start of the toolbar.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_VALUE_DESCRIPTION_: Own view of every value: { value, path, tokens, type }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_VALUE_TYPE_DESCRIPT: Own view of a type, e.g. value-boolean or value-color.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_COLLAPSE_ALL_DESC: Collapses all nodes (the root stays open).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_EXPAND_PATH_DESCR: Expands the parents of a path.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_EXPAND_TO_LEVEL_D: Expands the nodes up to a level.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_FOCUS_PATH_DESCRI: Shows a node and moves the focus to it.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_GET_TEXT_DESCRIPT: The document as text with the format options.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_REDO_DESCRIPTION_: Redoes the next step of the history.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_REMOVE_DESCRIPTIO: Removes the node of a path.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_RESET_DESCRIPTION: Goes back to the start value (a step of the history).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_SET_DESCRIPTION_: Sets the value of a path (a step of the history).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_UNDO_DESCRIPTION_: Undoes the last step of the history.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_VALIDATE_DESCRIPT: Checks the document: Promise with { isValid, errors }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Arrows move, Enter edits, the menu of a row has all actions. The model changes with every step.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_HISTORY_DESCRIPTION_: Every change is a step: the buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y go back and forward, the list of the steps jumps to a step, "reset" goes back to reset-value and can be undone too.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SEARCH_DESCRIPTION_: The search finds also inside collapsed nodes and opens them; Enter or F3 goes to the next match. The options: keys, values, case, regular expression and "only matches".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_VARIABLES_DESCRIPTION_: {{ name }} in a text is a chip; "{{" or Ctrl+Space in the field opens the list of the variables. Unknown names are errors with a suggestion, a number variable in a field of a boolean is a warning. The eye shows the values (variable-values), resolveVariables replaces them in code.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_RULES_DESCRIPTION_: rules by path ("*" for any index): the rows show the errors, the summary has links to the nodes, F8 goes to the next error, collapsed nodes count the errors inside. level: "warning" does not block.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SCHEMA_DESCRIPTION_: A subset of JSON Schema without a library. validate-on="blur" shows the errors when the editor loses the focus. "Add" takes the next key of properties and the type of the schema. A full JSON Schema can be checked with a library in validate-document.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_FORMAT_DESCRIPTION_: Tree and text side by side (mode="split"). The text uses the props: indent, sort-keys, inline-arrays, empty-containers, format-on="blur" (also escape-unicode, line-ending, trailing-newline, number-format…). The buttons format and minify the text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_MODEL_STRING_DESCRIPTION_: With model-type="string" the model is the formatted text (e.g. a field of a database); parse and stringify allow other formats.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_HOOKS_DESCRIPTION_: confirm-remove="containers" asks before an object or an array is removed. before-add gives the value of a new recipient, before-rename writes keys in camelCase, after-change writes a log, get-node-actions adds actions to the menu of a text.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION_: The plugin "color" finds colors, shows a swatch, edits them with a color field, warns about black, adds the action "invert" and a button of the toolbar. Global with app.use(AJsonEditorPlugin, { plugins }).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_RIGHTS_HEADER_: Rights: readonly paths, locked keys, depth
_A_JSON_EDITOR_RIGHTS_DESCRIPTION_: readonly-paths cannot be changed (the row says "read only"), locked-keys cannot be removed or renamed, hidden-paths are not shown, allowed-types limits the types (no null), max-depth the levels.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_READONLY_DESCRIPTION_: readonly keeps search, expand, the menu with copy and the text mode; the treegrid has aria-readonly="true".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_BIG_DESCRIPTION_: 3000 entries: from virtual-threshold only the visible rows are rendered, the treegrid keeps aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex, the keys work as before. array-page-size shows big arrays in pages.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm the element has the type jsonEditor; all props can be set in the element.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SLOTS_DESCRIPTION_: value-boolean shows the booleans as badges, status adds a text to the status bar.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EXAMPLE_SETTINGS_HELP_: The settings of the newsletter as JSON.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EXAMPLE_BLACK_: Black has a low contrast on dark backgrounds
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOW_FULLSCREEN_DE: The button "full screen": the Fullscreen API (Escape of the browser ends it), else a fixed layer.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MULTILINE_MAX_ROWS_: Maximal number of rows of the textarea of a string.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_MULTILINE_STRINGS_D: Strings are edited in a textarea (Enter saves, Shift+Enter adds a line); the view shows the first lines and "+N lines".
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_SELECTABLE_DESCRIPT: More rows can be selected (aria-multiselectable): Space, Shift+arrows, Ctrl / Shift + click, Ctrl+A; Delete, Alt+arrows, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X work on all of them as one step.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EVENTS_FULLSCREEN_DESCRIP: The full screen was changed: { isFullscreen }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_EVENTS_SELECTION_CHANGE_D: The selected rows were changed: { paths }.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_SELECTION_DESCRIPTION_: Space selects a row, Shift+arrows or Shift+click a range, Ctrl+click one more, Ctrl+A all; Escape clears. Delete, Alt+arrows, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V and the menu "Selected" work on all rows as one step of the history. The rows have aria-selected, the status bar says the number.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_MULTILINE_DESCRIPTION_: The text of the e-mail has line breaks: the tree shows the first 3 lines and "+N lines", the editor is a textarea (Enter saves, Shift+Enter adds a line, multiline-max-rows limits its height). The row says the number of the lines.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_FULLSCREEN_HEADER_: Full screen and defaults for all editors
_A_JSON_EDITOR_FULLSCREEN_DESCRIPTION_: The button "full screen" uses the Fullscreen API: the page behind it cannot be reached, Escape of the browser ends it; without the API a fixed layer that Escape ends. The visual props (density, show-types, max-height, modes, allow-fullscreen, selectable, multiline-strings…) can be set for all editors with AComponentsPlugin; a prop of the editor wins.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_REPAIR_DESCRIPTION_: When the text is no JSON, the button Repair appears next to the error. It shows the changes with their lines and the result first; Apply makes them one step of the history (Ctrl+Z undoes it). It repairs comments, single and typographic quotes, keys without quotes, missing and extra commas, True / None / undefined / NaN, +1 / .5, line breaks in strings, missing brackets and quotes and several values at the root. Also as a function: repairJson(text).
_A_JSON_EDITOR_REPLACE_DESCRIPTION_: The button next to the search (or Ctrl+H) opens the field Replace with: Replace (Enter) changes the current match, Replace all (Ctrl+Enter) all matches as one step of the history. Strings and keys are replaced (numbers and booleans stay), with a regular expression $1 inserts a group. Read-only nodes, locked keys and keys that exist already are skipped, the hooks before-set and before-rename run. The method replace(text, { all }) does the same.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_READY_PLUGINS_DESCRIPTION: AJsonEditorPlugins contains all ready plugins, each one can be used alone: AJsonEditorColorPlugin (swatch, AColorPicker as the editor), AJsonEditorDatePlugin (date and date with time in ISO format, localized view, ADateInput as the editor), AJsonEditorImagePlugin (picture and link), AJsonEditorUrlPlugin (link to a new window, the action Open link for the keyboard), AJsonEditorSwitchPlugin (a boolean as a switch, a click toggles it). An enum of the schema or of the rules is always edited with a select.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_BIG_NUMBERS_DESCRIPTION_: JavaScript keeps only about 15–17 digits exactly: 12345678901234567890 becomes 12345678901234567000. The prop big-numbers decides what happens with such numbers of a JSON text: "warn" (default) shows a warning at the node and refuses such a number in the editor, "bigint" keeps integers exactly as BigInt, "string" keeps them as strings. The paths are found with JSON.parse and the source of the numbers (JSON.parse source text access); without it only a warning for the document.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_ALLOW_REPLACE_DESCR: Shows "Replace" and "Replace all" at the search (<kbd>Ctrl+H</kbd>). Only strings and keys are replaced. The default can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_PROPS_BIG_NUMBERS_DESCRIP: Numbers of a JSON text that JavaScript can not keep exactly: "warn" (a warning, the number is rounded, the editor refuses such numbers), "bigint" (integers as BigInt), "string" (as strings). The default can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_JSON_EDITOR_METHODS_REPLACE_DESCRIPTI: replace(text, { all = true }): replaces the matches of the current search (all or the current one) as one step of the history; returns { count, skipped }.
